meaning: Only compact original-pixel-detail generation changes. Every point action still requires a canonical current candidate ID and forbids secondary targeting aliases. A native nonblank target_text is now required except when the model selects an original anonymous_without_ocr candidate, for which null/empty remains allowed. Native text permits the existing fresh-observation text relocation; no stale-ID guard, runtime code, OCR, model, semantic contract, repairv5 or global budget changed. No native reply, label or ID is filled or replaced locally. Detailed image selection/bytes and the default-disabled feature remain unchanged. Versionv4 identifies the compact schema. Related tests cover null/empty/whitespace readable-ID rejection and actual native-text relocation against fresh IDs/moved geometry without mutating the PlanStep. Saved production probes on two ended development frames are one request each, not live acceptance or heldout accuracy.
limitations: Model can still choose wrong or ambiguous targets; only large anonymous contours receive bounded crops. Original per-stage/event/pixel acceptance and all runtime guards remain necessary.
